metadata.policy_warning: All entries below are dated seed reference candidates as of 20 October 2026. The system verifies live status against SEBI/NSE/BSE before promoting any timetable as confirmed. Never treat reference dates or grey-market premiums as subscription advice.

candidates.theme_summary: Telecom, digital services, hyperscale cloud and gigawatt-scale AI infrastructure.
candidates.use_of_proceeds: 5G/6G network expansion, sovereign AI cloud & data-centre infrastructure capex, debt repayment, and general corporate purposes.
candidates.customer_concentration_risk: LOW (480M+ retail subscribers and broad enterprise base).
candidates.litigation_and_contingent_liabilities: Telecom spectrum/AGR regulatory disputes disclosed under contingent liabilities.
candidates.related_party_transactions_flag: MODERATE — Extensive inter-group infrastructure and retail agreements with Reliance Industries subsidiaries.
candidates.auditor_qualifications: Unqualified restated audit opinion; verify latest RHP addendum.
candidates.ai_relevance_assessment: DIRECT_INFRASTRUCTURE_AND_TELECOM — Core telecom revenue dominates today, with expanding sovereign AI cloud and data-centre capacity.

history.note: Seeded from reference Oct 2026 RHP filing; requires live NSE/SEBI confirmation before treating 21-23 Oct 2026 dates as active.

candidates.theme_summary: Contract manufacturing marketplace and precision industrial/electronics supply chain execution.
candidates.use_of_proceeds: Expansion of electronics/IT hardware manufacturing facilities, working capital for industrial EPC/supply-chain operations, and investor OFS.
candidates.customer_concentration_risk: MODERATE — Diversified across consumer electronics, renewables, aerospace and industrial B2B buyers.
candidates.litigation_and_contingent_liabilities: Standard working-capital, vendor and indirect tax proceedings recorded in RHP.
candidates.auditor_qualifications: Check RHP restated financial notes on revenue recognition (gross vs net GMV) and inventory provisioning.
candidates.ai_relevance_assessment: INDIRECT_MANUFACTURING_EMS — Primarily industrial contract manufacturing and consumer/IT EMS; do not classify as a pure-play AI company.

history.note: RHP and addendum filings reported in Oct 2026; verify whether issue has opened, closed, listed or been postponed.

candidates.theme_summary: Solar EPC, renewable energy project development and commercial/industrial energy infrastructure.
candidates.use_of_proceeds: Working capital for renewable EPC execution, investment in solar IPP SPVs, and general corporate purposes.
candidates.customer_concentration_risk: HIGH — Project-driven EPC revenue concentrated in C&I solar clients.
candidates.litigation_and_contingent_liabilities: Bank guarantees and EPC performance obligations typical of solar contractors.
candidates.ai_relevance_assessment: INDIRECT_ENERGY_INFRASTRUCTURE — Treat as an energy infrastructure candidate, not a direct data-centre supplier unless captive DC PPA contracts are disclosed.

history.note: DRHP filing reported in Oct 2026; no confirmed IPO subscription timetable yet.

candidates.theme_summary: Power conductors, LT/HT cables and electrical transmission cabling.
candidates.use_of_proceeds: Capacity expansion for power cables/conductors, working capital requirements, and partial promoter OFS.
candidates.customer_concentration_risk: HIGH — Significant exposure to state transmission utilities and EPC contractors.
candidates.litigation_and_contingent_liabilities: Working-capital bank guarantees and utility tender disputes.
candidates.related_party_transactions_flag: MODERATE — Group entity raw-material and lease transactions.
candidates.auditor_qualifications: None noted in DRHP summary; requires manual verification of latest addendum.
candidates.ai_relevance_assessment: INDIRECT_GRID_SUPPLY_CHAIN — Supplies electrical cables/conductors for grid expansion; verify if any EHV/data-centre approvals exist.

history.note: DRHP addendum reported in Oct 2026; subscription dates and valuation not yet finalised.

candidates.theme_summary: Advanced electro-optics, thermal imaging sensors, embedded vision and defence electronics.
candidates.use_of_proceeds: Predominantly Offer for Sale (OFS) by existing investors; company receives no fresh issue proceeds if 100% OFS.
candidates.customer_concentration_risk: HIGH — Defence ministries and prime defence contractors in India and export markets.
candidates.litigation_and_contingent_liabilities: Export control compliance and defence contract performance guarantees.
candidates.related_party_transactions_flag: LOW_TO_MODERATE — IP and R&D subsidiary arrangements.
candidates.auditor_qualifications: Verify RHP for intangible R&D capitalisation policies.
candidates.ai_relevance_assessment: SPECIALISED_EDGE_VISION_ONLY — Edge AI/computer vision for defence electro-optics; NOT a data-centre infrastructure supplier.

history.note: RHP filing reported in Oct 2026; evaluate edge-AI imaging merits separately from data-centre infrastructure.
